note: Fragment list for build.mjs. Which modules land in which artifact is decided by src/targets.json. A fragment names the fragment it follows in `after`, and build.mjs derives the load order from those references, so the position of an entry in this array no longer fixes when it loads: splice a new block by pointing its first fragment's `after` at its predecessor and the old successor's `after` at the block's last fragment. Only `file`, `module`, `after` and `note` are read; nothing here is derived from the built files, because a recorded byte or line count cannot be kept true by hand.
